title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary: Bitcoin slips 0.3% to close at $64,520 as fear dominates with a 29 reading on the index. Price action stayed contained through the US session with no decisive break. Network strength stands out: hashrate holds at 1061 EH/s while the mempool carries 99,672 transactions at a low 3 sat/vB fee. Block height sits at 958,803. Overnight watch centers on whether low fees clear the backlog or volume picks up to test support near 64k.
